fusions.name: Split Shove
fusions.desc: Drives a bolt of force into the first enemy it meets, which deals 8 damage, then splits off to 1 more enemy within 4 tiles for 60% of that. Holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Both Ways at Once
fusions.desc: Thrusts out 2 bolts of force in diverging directions; each deals 12 damage and knocks its target back 2.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Turned Aside
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 30% of the damage you take is sent back to whoever dealt it, and your armour rises by 10%.

fusions.name: Second Prong
fusions.desc: When you land a critical hit, the excess force branches into the nearest enemy within 6 tiles and deals 8 damage. Once every 4 seconds.
